consent.title: Informed Consent
consent.readCarefully: Please read all sections below carefully and confirm your understanding by checking the respective boxes.

purpose.title: 1. Purpose of the Cluster
purpose.content: This cluster examines the effectiveness of platform tools and processes on participants' overall delivery outcomes. The cluster is transparent and open. The goal is to collect data on subjective and objective quality indicators.

procedures.title: 2. Cluster Procedures
procedures.content: As a participant, you will regularly complete questionnaires about your delivery status, use assigned tools as recommended, and potentially undergo assessments with partner organizations. Your participation is entirely voluntary.

risks.title: 3. Possible Risks
risks.content: Platform tools are designed with safety and reliability in mind. In case of any issues, contact the cluster team immediately.

benefits.title: 4. Possible Benefits
benefits.content: Participants may experience improvements in monitored health parameters. Additionally, you will gain access to diagnostic tests and personalized health monitoring. Your data will contribute to scientific knowledge.

privacy.title: 5. Data Protection
privacy.content: Your personal data will be processed in accordance with GDPR. Data will be anonymized for research purposes. You have the right to access, correct, and delete your data. Details can be found in our privacy policy.

withdrawal.title: 6. Right to Withdraw
withdrawal.content: You may withdraw from the cluster at any time without giving a reason and without any negative consequences. To withdraw, contact the cluster team or use the 'My Clusters' section in your profile.
